title: Encyclopedia of Parentheses
priorityReason: Prefix invariant ба жижиг N-д exhaustive enumeration-ийг зөв сонгох суурь дадал; odd N, early negative prefix болон lexicographic order-ийг ялгана.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: N<=20 permits exhaustive bracket generation; prefix balance, final balance and lexicographic output require explicit invariants. Not official.

title: Longest Circular Road
priorityReason: Tree diameter-ийг cycle objective-т хувиргах ажиглалт болон хоёр traversal-ийн хэрэглээ; graph/tree суурийн өгөөжтэй practice.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: Reduce added-cycle optimum to tree diameter plus one, then two BFS traversals; more reasoning than basic tree traversal. Not official.

title: Smallest Subsequence
priorityReason: Greedy сонголтод feasibility үлдээх баталгаа, subsequence/substring ялгаа болон next occurrence preprocessing-ийг холбоно.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: Lexicographic greedy with remaining-length feasibility and next-occurrence preprocessing; nontrivial dominance proof. Not official.

title: AtCounter
priorityReason: Subsequence DP-ийн state/transition болон index-distinct counting-ийн цөм жишээ; modular arithmetic-тай хослоно.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: Fixed-target subsequence-count DP, skip/take transitions and modular arithmetic; no witness reconstruction. Not official.

title: Score Sum Queries
priorityReason: Prefix sum-ийн үндсэн range identity-г хоёр ангилалд давтан хэрэглэж эзэмшүүлэх стандарт practice.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: Two category prefix sums and inclusive range subtraction; basic indexing and initialization. Not official.

title: Red Painting
priorityReason: Dynamic connectivity-г DSU-д хувиргах, inactive vertex-ийг ижил root байсан ч connected гэж үзэхгүй байх чухал ялгааг сургана.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: Incremental grid activation with DSU, active-endpoint checks and coordinate flattening; simpler than CF25D repair construction1900. Not official.

title: Passing
priorityReason: Shortest-path decomposition ба хоёр эхлэлээс distance тооцох дахин ашиглагддаг pattern; single-source хэрэгслийг өргөтгөнө.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: Two Dijkstra runs and path-through-vertex decomposition,64-bit distances; no path reconstruction. CF20C1900 is an imperfect algorithmic anchor. Not official.

title: We Used to Sing a Song Together
priorityReason: Sorting greedy-г зөвхөн heuristic биш exchange argument-аар батлах цөм practice; matching objective-ийн талыг харуулна.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: Sorted minimum-absolute matching needs an uncrossing/exchange proof and64-bit objective. Comparable reasoning load to sorted-window CF580B1500. Not official.

title: Minimum Coins
priorityReason: Олон loop-оос нэг хувьсагчийг equation-оор арилгах, constraint-based search болон greedy counterexample-ийн суурь practice.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: Eliminate one of three coin-count variables using divisibility; choose bounded enumeration despite large target. Not official.

title: Come Back in One Piece
priorityReason: SCC-ийн утгыг pair-counting-д шууд ашиглаж graph condensation-ийн суурийг эзэмшүүлэх practice.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: Recognize mutual reachability as SCC membership and count unordered pairs; SCC modelling comparable to CF427C1700. Not official.

title: Cubic Cake
priorityReason: GCD-г хуваагдах геометрийн нөхцөлтэй холбох, minimum objective-г largest divisor руу хувиргах цөм тооны онолын practice.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: GCD divisibility and minimum-cut arithmetic, including64-bit dimensions; one mathematical reduction. Not official.

title: Select + or - One
priorityReason: Necessary/sufficient нөхцөлийг ялгаж батлах, parity invariant ба илүүдэл үйлдлийн constructive argument-ийн суурь practice.
ratingBasis: Rough CF-scale calibration: Minimum L1 moves plus parity of extra operations; necessary-and-sufficient proof rather than simulation. Not official.
